messages:
maya: Quick note — starting Odyssey LoRA onboarding into raven-int4-spline. Did a fast smoke and saw weird spacing around numbers/currency and some date tokenization oddities. Sharing results and need triage before we can canary.
liam: can you paste one concrete failing example and which quant/merge flags you used?
maya: failing example: "Total due: $1,200.00" -> model outputs "Total due: $ 1,200 . 00". Also "Dec 3rd, 2021" -> "Dec 3 rd ,2021". Happens mostly where comma/period and thousands separators are present.

Config: int4-static, kv-cache=on, used new spline-fuse stitch strategy during merge, token-map = cust-odyssey.json. Ran token-sync v2 before merging.
arun: okay that looks like tokenizer boundary or detokenization spacing introduced post-merge. Did you run the tokenizer diagnostic? any token-id mismatches vs base?
maya: ran a quick token-diff; most ids match but there are ~30 custom tokens mapped differently. embed-check looked fine (small drift). Attached smoke evalpack and diffs to S3.
eval-bot: smoke results summary: accuracy=0.92, tokenized-match-drop=0.06 on currency/date cases, top1-exact-match delta = -8% vs raven-int4 baseline. Diff bundle: s3://redwood/odyssey/smoke/diffs/4170012345.zip
nora: assigning to myself to triage. I'll repro locally with quant seed=42. maya drop the promptset and the exact merge command?
maya: merge command used:
```
./merge_lora --base raven-int4 --lora odyssey-v3 --strategy spline-fuse --quant int4-static --token-map cust-odyssey.json
```
Promptset: gs://rdw-evals/odyssey/smoke_prompts_v1.json
infra-bot: ephemeral job created: run-odyssey-4170012345 (eng-ml-nightly). Logs: https://ci.redwood/run/4170012345
nora: thanks. plan: 1) try reproduce with generic token-map to isolate tokenmap vs merge effect; 2) rerun merge with per-layer-rescale=false; 3) run with kv-cache=false to rule out runtime detokenization interaction.
liam: also try a quick binary-search remerge disabling spline-fuse to see if it's specific to the new strategy. If reproduced, snapshot model and we can bisect layers.
maya: will ping with results. tagging here if I hit a blocking repro: @nora @liam @arun :thumbsup:
